title: Sonar Municipal: semantic search pipeline for Brazilian municipal bills
description: Source code accompanying the ICMC-USP undergraduate thesis 'Mineração de Dados e Busca Semântica Aplicadas à Análise de Projetos de Lei Municipais' (Sonar Municipal project). Implements the SAPL data collection pipeline, dense-retrieval indexing with E5 and BM25 baselines, and the evaluation tooling for the companion TREC-style benchmark. Funded by AI4PEP (Artificial Intelligence for Public Health Emergency Preparedness) network, supported by IDRC (International Development Research Centre, Canada). Companion artifacts on the Hugging Face Hub: model thiagoambiel/sonar_municipal_ptt5_ementa2action, dataset thiagoambiel/sonar-municipal-pl-actions, demo thiagoambiel/sonar-municipal-demo. Companion Zenodo records (dataset, model) will be cross-linked once their DOIs are minted; thesis BDTD-USP handle to be linked in v1.0 post-defense.
